tei:div.tei:p: "$ (323)༄// theg pa chen po shin tu rgyas pa'i lugs kyi sems bskyed dang sdom pa'i cho ga byang chub sems dpa'i lam bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

(324) ༄༅// phun tshogs srid zhi'i phan bde ji snyed rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mthu las byung*// sangs rgyas rgyal ba'i sras po nyid dang de yang byang sems las 'khrungs phyir// rin chen rin thang med pa'i mchog sbyin dge ba'i bshes la gus btud nas// shin tu rgyas pa'i sems bskyed cho ga gzhan la phan phyir gsal bar bshad/ 'di ltar 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge legs mtha' dag gi 'byung gnas/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bla ma/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi yab/ gcig tu skyon gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa gtan nas spangs shing*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho nyams pa med pa la dbang 'byor pa/ yid can thams cad kyi ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes gcig pu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par 'dod pas/ de yi thabs byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas rgyal sras kyi spyod pa la 'jug dgos/ de'ang thog mar sdom pa'i cho ga la ltos pas/ ji skad bshad pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis/ rigs dang skal bar ldan pa'i slob ma rnams byang chub chen po'i lam du gzhug pa'i phyir/ theg pa chen po shin tu rgyas pa'i lugs kyi sems bskyed dang sdom pa'i cho ga byed par 'dod pas sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ gnas gtsang zhing yid du 'ong bar/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang po shā kya seng ge'i snang brnyan gtso bor gyur pa'i rten khyad par can gyi drung du/ nyer spyod spyi dang*/ khyad par spos/ mar me zhal zas rnams kyi phreng ba tshar du dngar bas mtshon ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa rnam gtsang zhing bkod pas mdzes pa dang*/ gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ zlum gtor dkar po gnyis dang*/ gzhi bdag gi gtor ma'ang bshams/ de nas slob dpon rang nyid khrus bya/ grub na sems bskyed dang sdom pa blang*// (325)gang ltar yang ltung bshags sogs chos spyod kyi rim pa ji ltar rigs par bya/

de nas stan mthon po la 'dug ste/ slob ma rnams phyi rol tu khrus byas/ nang du rang rang gi stan dpa' bar me tog dang bcas te gus pa'i tshul gyis 'khod du gzhug go /gnyis pa dngos bzhi ni// slob dpon gyis chos thams cad stong pa nyid du rtogs pa'i shes rab dang*/ sems can thams cad phan bde la 'god par 'dod pa'i brtse ba dang*/ khyed par slob ma rnams la byang chub kyi sems bskyed par 'dod pa'i bsam pa bzang po dang ldan pas/ gsal zhing snyan pa'i ngag gis 'di skad ces brda sprod par bya'o/ 'o skol rnams kyi rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor gyi rten khyad par can rnyed/ mjal bar dka' ba'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dang mjal/ 'khor 'das kyi 'dam ga rang dbang yod pa'i dus 'dir dal 'byor la snying po len pa'i chos rnam par dag pa zhig la ci nas kyang 'bad dgos te/ slob dpon chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ rgya mtsho gcig gnas gnya' shing bu ga dang*// rus sbal 'phrad pa bas kyang dud 'gro las// mi nyid ches thob dka' bas mi dbang gis// dam chos spyad pas nga 'bras mchis par mdzod// zhes gsungs shing*/ dam chos kyi nang nas kyang*/ rang gzhan thams cad sdug bsngal cha dang bcas pa las sgrol zhing gnas skabs dang*/ mthar thug gi bde ba thams cad thob par byed pa'i rgyu bsod nams dang yon tan mtha' yas pa'i gter du gyur pa ni byang chub kyi sems kho na yin te/ slob dpon chen po (326)zhi ba lhas/ sdug bsngal mthar 'byin 'dod pa dang*// bde ba'i mthar yang 'gro 'dod pas// dad pa'i rtsa ba brtan byas nas// byang chub la ni blo brtan bya// zhes dang*/ slob dpon chen po tsan+d+ra go mīs/ phyogs dus kun na bzhugs pa yi// byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi khams// bsod nams kun gyi gter gyur gang*/ zhes gsungs pas mtshon rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas bsgrod pa gcig pa'i lam du bsngags par mdzad pa byang chub kyi sems de yang kun rdzob cho ga las thob pa dang*/

don dam bsgom pa'i stobs kyis skyes pa gnyis las/ dang po la/ bskyed bya sems kyi mtshan nyid ni/ gzhan don du rdzogs byang la dmigs pa'i theg chen slob pa'i sems gang zhig byang 'phags kyi mnyam bzhag gi ngo bor gyur pa'i sems bskyed rnam par bcad pa'o// mtshan gzhi ni// theg chen tshogs sbyor ba'i rgyud kyi sems bskyed rnams dang byang 'phags kyi rjes thob kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i sems bskyed lta bu'o// dbye na/ grogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi stobs dang*/ rgyu rigs sad pa'i stobs dang*/ 'bras bu dge rtsa rgyas pa'i stobs dang*/ lam theg chen gyi sde snod thos pa'i stobs dang*/ thos pa de nyid mang du goms pas bskyed pa dang lnga las/ dang po ni/ grogs la rag las pas mi brtan pa'i sems bskyed dang*/ phyi ma bzhi ni mi mthun phyogs kyis nyams dka' bas brtan pa'i sems bskyed de/ mdo sde rgyan las/ grogs stobs rgyu stobs rtsa ba'i stobs// thos stobs dge ba goms pa las// mi brtan pa dang brtan 'byung ba// gzhan gyis bstan pa'i sems bskyed bshad/ ces gsungs pa ltar/ gtso bor gzhan gyi mthu las byung ba kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems de la'ang ma thob pa thob par byed pa'i cho ga /thob pa mi nyams par bsrung ba'i tshul/ nyams na phyir bcos pa rnams su 'du ba las/ 'dir dang po ma thob pa thob par byed pa sems bskyed dang sdom pa'i cho ga bgyid pa'i skabs su babs pa (327)lags/ de yang 'di la sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyi gsungs las/ sems bskyed la dbu ma lugs dang*/ sems tsam lugs gnyis yod/ dbu ma lugs ni sdong po bkod pa dang*/ nam mkha'i snying pos zhus pa la sogs pa'i mdo'i rjes su 'brangs/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis gsungs/ slob dpon chen po klu sgrub nas brgyud/ slob dpon chen po zhi ba lha yi lugs/ slob dpon chen po dgra las rnam rgyal la sogs pa'i phyag len/

bstan pa'i mnga' bdag chen po dpal ldan sa skya pa la sogs pas mdzad pa 'di yin/ sems tsam lugs ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod la sogs pa'i mdo'i rjes su 'brangs/ 'phags pa byams pas gsungs/ 'phags pa thogs med nas brgyud/ slob dpon chen po tsan+d+ra go mī'i lugs/ jo bo chen po rje yi phyag len/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bka' gdams pa rnams kyis mdzad pa 'di yin/ 'di gnyis la blang ba'i yul/ len pa po'i gang zag /len pa'i cho ga/ blangs nas srung tshul/ nyams na phyir bcos pa rnams la mi 'dra pa'i khyad par mang du yod ces gsungs shing*/ yang mkhas pa 'ga' zhig de gnyis kyi dbye ba dang khyad par la sogs pa mi 'thad ces gsungs kyang*/ 'dir de lta bu'i dgag sgrub kyi rim pa rnams btang snyoms su bzhag nas// slob dpon chen po 'phags pa thogs med dang*/ ngo bo rje dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na'i gsung rab las 'byung ba ltar/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas/ bdag cag gi yongs su 'dzin pa chen po'i bar du brgyud pa bar ma chad pa las byon pa'i phyag len bzhin 'bul ba la don rnam pa gsum ste sems bskyed dang sdom pa'i rten nges par bya ba dang*/ sbyor ba rjes su sgrub pa dang*/ rang bzhin gtan la dbab pa'o// dang po rten nges par bya ba la gsum ste/ sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i mtha' la skyo ba bskyed pa dang*/ zhi ba myang (328)'das kyi mtha' la zhen pa dgag pa dang*/ mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i byang chub kyi sems la spro ba bskyed pa'o// dang po sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i mtha' la skyo ba bskyed pa ni 'di ltar nges par bya ste/ 'o skol rnams kyis dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob pa'i skabs 'dir/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las brgal zhing*/ bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'i phyir 'bad dgos/ de yi rgyu mtshan yang don de gnyis rten 'di la sgrub nus shing gzhan gyis mi nus pa'i phyir te/

slob spring las/ gang zhig thob na skye ba'i rgya mtsho mthar 'byin zhing*// byang chub mchog gi sa bon dge ba'ang 'debs byed pa// yid bzhin nor bu bas kyang yon tan ches lhag pa'i// mi nyid thob nas su zhig 'bras bu med par byed// bde gshegs lam rten 'gro ba 'dren par chas gyur cing*/ sems kyi stobs chen mi yis rnyed pa gang yin pa'i// lam de lha dang klu yis mi rnyed lha min dang*// mkha' lding rig 'dzin mi'am ci dang lto 'phyes min// zhes gsungs so// dal 'byor de'ang rnyed par dka' ste/ sdong po bkod pa las/ mir gyur pa'ang rnyed par dka'/ dal ba phun sum tshogs pa rnam par dag pa'ang rnyed par dka'/ zhes gsungs shing*/ slob dpon zhi ba lhas/ mi yi gru la brten nas ni// sdug bsngal chu bo che las sgrol// gru 'di phyi nas rnyed dka' yis// rmongs pa dus su gnyid ma log /ces gsungs// rnyed pa de yang dus ring du mi gnas te/ 'phags pa klu sgrub gyis/ tshe 'dir gnod mang rlung gis btab pa yi// chu yi chu bur bas kyang mi rtag na// dbugs dbyung dbugs rngub nyid kyis log pa las// sad khoms gang lags de ni ngo mtshar che// zhes gsungs pas/ myur du dge ba la 'bad dgos/ de la ma 'bad par sdig pa byas na ngan 'gror ltung ste/ zhi ba lhas/ dge ba dag kyang ma byas la// sdig pa dag kyang nyer bsags na// bskal pa bye ba (329)brgyar yang ni// bde 'gro'i sgra yang thos mi 'gyur/ zhes gsungs shing*/ ngan song du skyes na dmyal ba la tsha grang la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa yod de/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ 'di na nyin gcig mdung thung sum brgya yis// rab tu drag btab sdug bsngal gang yin pa// des ni dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal chung ngu la'ang*// 'ol yang mi nye char yang mi phod do// zhes gsungs so// yi dwags la yang bkres skom la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal mang po yod de/

yi dwags na yang 'dod pas phongs pa yis// bskyed pa'i sdug bsngal rgyun chags mi 'chos pa// bkres skom grang dro dal dang 'jigs pa yis// bskyed pa shin tu mi bzad bsten 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs so// dud 'gro la yang*/ gcig la gcig za ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal yod de// dud 'gro'i skye gnas na yang bsad pa dang*// bcings dang brdeg sogs sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa// zhi 'gyur dge ba spangs pa rnams la ni// gcig la gcig za shin tu mi bzad pa/ zhes gsungs pas sdig pa spong ba la 'bad dgos shing*/ dge ba yang thar pa'i lam du 'gyur bar ma sgrub na bsod nams dang mi g.yo ba'i las kyis bde 'gror skyes kyang de dag kha cig la sdug bsngal chen po yod cing*/ de med pa rnams kyang de nas shi 'phos nas dmyal ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur te/ lha yul 'dod bde shin tu chen po dang*// tshangs nyid chags bral bde ba thob nas slar// mnar med me yi bud shing 'gyur ba yi// sdug bsngal rgyun mi 'chad pa bsten 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs so// mdor na 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin te/ mgon po byams pas/ mi gtsang ba la dri zhim med bzhin 'gro lnga dag la bde ba med// de yi sdug bsngal rtag tu me mtshon rgya tshwa la sogs reg skyes (330)bzhin/ ces gsungs pas de la thar ba'i thabs la 'bad dgos te/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ mgo 'am gos la glo bur me shor na// de dag zlog phyir bgyi ba btang nas kyang*// yang srid med par bgyi slad 'bad 'tshal te// de bas ches mchog dgos pa gzhan ma mchis/ zhes gsungs pas/ 'khor ba las thar bar bya ba'i phyir dam pa'i chos la 'bad par bya'o snyams pa'i bsam pa zhe thag pa nas bskyed bar zhu// gnyis pa zhi ba myang 'das kyi mtha' la zhen pa dgag pa ni/ rang nyid 'khor ba las thar kyang gzhan gyi don rgyun chad pa'i phung po lhag med kyi myang 'das don du gnyer ba ni/

ma chus khyer ba mthong zhing gdon pa'i nus pa yod bzhin du de mi 'don par rang nyid skams na yid bde bar gnas pa ltar shin tu mi rig pa'i phyir theg chen pas don du gnyer bya ma yin te/ slob dpon chen po tsan+d+ra go mīs/ nye du 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i nang du chud gyur ba// klong gi nang du lhung ba lta bur song bzhin du// skye shi 'phos pas ngo ma shes pa de bor nas// gal te gcig thar byed na de las khrel khon med// byis pa pang na btsas pa ci yang mi nus pas// gang gi nu zho byams pa'i shugs kyis zag 'thungs pa// ngal ba mang bsten byams pas bsten bde dag 'dir// shin tu ma rabs shig na'ang spang bar su zhig spro/ zhes gsungs pas/ gzhan don dor nas rang nyid gcig pu zhi bde thob par 'dod pa'i blo spang 'tshal lo// gsum pa mtha' gnyis dang bral pa'i byang chub kyi sems la spro ba bskyed pa ni/ mgon po byams pas/ bdag sred ma lus shes rab kyis bcad nas// sems can sred phyir blo ldan zhi thob min// de ltar blo rtse byang chub thabs bsten nas// 'phags pa 'khor ba'am mya ngan 'das mi 'gyur// zhes pa ltar 'khor 'das gnyis la mi gnas pa'i myang 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes bya ba sgrib pa (331)bag chags dang bcas pa spangs/ shes bya ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mngon sum du mkhyen/ phrin las tshad las 'das shing rgyun mi 'chad par 'bad med lhun grub tu mdzad pa de thob par bya ba yin la/ de'i rgyu'ang byang chub kyi sems yin te/ mdo sdud pa las/ chu yi thig pas bum pa dang po tha ma'i bar// rim gyis nyung ngu nyung ngus de yongs 'gegs pa ltar// de bzhin dang po'i sems kyang byang chub mchog rgyu ste// rim gyis dkar po'i yon tan rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'gyur// zhes gsungs shing*/ rnam snang mngon byang las kyang*/ gsang ba'i bdag po thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes de ni snying rje'i rtsa ba las byung ba yin/

byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyu las byung ba yin// thabs kyis mthar phyin pa yin no// zhes gsungs/ sdong po bkod pa las kyang*/ rigs kyi bu byang chub kyi sems ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad bskyed pas sa bon lta bu'o// zhes gsungs pas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i phyir byang chub tu sems bskyed par bya'o snyams pa'i 'dun pa drag po dung pa re bskyed mdzod/ gnyis pa sbyor ba rjes su sgrub pa la gnyis te/ smon pa dang 'jug pa'o// dang po la'ang sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi sbyor ba la gsum ste/ yul khyad par can la gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ rten khyad par can la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ thabs khyad par can gyi sgo nas tshogs bsags pa'o// dang po yul khyad par can la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs nas/ phyag dang mchod pa phul te dge ba'i bshes gnyen la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed la phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul nas 'di ltar gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ zhes 'byung bas/ thog mar khyed rang rnams kyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la mos gus gdung shug drags pos (332)gsol ba btab pas mdun gyi nam mkhar mngon sum lta bur byon pa la phyag dang mchod pa phul ba'i yid kyis yan lag ma lnga sa la gtug pa'i phyag dang bcas te 'di gsung bar zhu/ ji snyed su dag

/sogs nas/ rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi// bar lan gcig / slar yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed de phyag gsum mdzad bar zhu/ zhes brjod la phyag gsum 'tshal du gzhug /de nas smon pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ zhes brda sbyar la/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma spyi ltar/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la gron pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa zhu ba'i yon du sogs sbyar la 'bul du gzhug / de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas phyag snyims pa me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzad par zhu/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sa chen po la bzhugs pa rnams kyis/ dang por bla na med par yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du/ rang rang gi ming nas smos te/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yang*/ slob dpon gyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /gnyis pa rten khyad par can la skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ thun mong gi skyabs 'gro las khyad par gsum gyis khyad par du 'phags pa'i theg chen gyi skyabs 'gro byed pa yin te/ dus kyi khyad par ni byang chub snying po'i bar yin la/ yul gyi khyad par ni/ sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi bdag nyid/ rtogs pa'i chos theg chen gyi 'gog lam dang*/ lung gi chos theg chen gyi gsung rab/ dge 'dun ni byang sems 'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa rnams yin no// bsam pa'i khyad par ni// sems can thams (333)cad kyis thog ma med pa nas lan grangs dpag tu med par phan btags pas drin che la/ drin chen de rnams 'khor ba sdug bsngal drag la yun ring bas gtses shing las dang nyon mongs pa'i 'ching bas bcings pas thar pa'i thabs med pas re snying rje snyam du bsams la/

'di rnams gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba dang ldan zhing sdug bsngal dang bral bar bdag gis byed dgos pa la/ da lta bdag la de'i nus pa med cing*/ de ltar nus pa sangs rgyas kho na yin pas bdag gis sangs rgyas thob par byed dgos/ de'ang dkon mchog la rags las pas/ bdag gis sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las sgrol nus kyi sangs rgyas thob pa'i don du dkon mchog la skyabs shing blo gtong bas bdag de ltar 'gyur bar dkon mchog mkhyen snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po bya ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ de ni de dngos 'dod pas khas len de yang snying rje las rig bya/ zhes gsungs pas da lta bdag la sems can sdug bsngal las sgrol ba'i nus pa mi 'dug pas/ ma lag zha ma'i bu chus khyer ba gzhan la rab mda' zlog zer ba ltar drin can sems can rnams/ sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung gi chus khyer ro rab mda' zlog zer ba'i tshul du byed pa yin gsung*/ des na da lta sems can rnams sdug bsngal las sgrol ba dang*/ ma 'ongs pa na bdag la sems can thams cad sgrol ba'i nus pa yod pa dkon mchog mkhyen snyams pa'i bsam pa khyad par can dang ldan pas/ bdag kyang rmi lam dang sgyu ma ltar bden pa med par shes par byas nas/ sems gzhan du ma yengs par rtse gcig pa'i yid kyis skyabs su 'gro ba 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gnang bar zhu/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ rang rang gi ming nas smos te/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi (334)mchog sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ /rang rang gi ming nas smos te/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyid pa dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ chos rnams kyi mchog zhi ba 'dod chags dang bral ba'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// slob dpon dgongs su gsol/

/rang rang gi ming nas smos te/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ tshogs rnams kyi mchog 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa' phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes pas skyabs su song nas/ de yi bslab bya la/ deng phyin chad sangs rgyas la ston pa/ theg chen gyi chos la lam/ byang sems 'phags pa rnams la lam sgrub pa'i grogs su bzung ba'i bsam sbyor brtan po bskyed dgos pa lags/ gsum pa thabs khyad par can gyi sgo nas tshogs gsog cing sgrib pa sbyong ba ni/ 'ga' zhig phyag dang mchod pa tsam las mi mdzad na'ang*/ jo bo chen pos yan lag bdun tshang bar byed par bshad pas/ thog mar yan lag bdun pa 'bul pa'i yul gsal gdab pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bstan pa'i bdag po bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po la/ 'khor nye ba'i sras brgyad la sogs pas bskor bas gtso byas pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa bzhugs par bsam la/ de rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig pa'i spyan sngar bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyis lus zhing gi rdul snyed du sprul nas/ sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal pa'i mos pas/ rjes zlos kyi tshig rnams dal zhing dod la skabs phyed par brjod pa shin tu gal che bas/ yan lag ma lnga sa la gtugs pa'i phyag dang bcas ste 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ (335)sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes tshig bcad re dang phyag re sbrag pa lan gsum byed du gzhug /de bzhin du/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa// thams cad mkhyen pa ston pa po// bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing*// de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo// dag pa 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu// dge bas ngan song las sgrol zhing*// gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa// zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo// grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston// bslab pa dag la rab tu gus// zhing gi dam pa yon tan ldan// dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo/

/zhes phyag dang bcas te byar gzhug go /de ltar bla ma dang dkon mchog la phyag 'tshal ba sngon du song nas/ gnyis pa mchod pa 'bul ba la lnga las/ dang po dngos su bshams pa'i mchod pa ni/ thog mar slob dpon gyis so so'i rig pas byin gyis brlabs par bya ba yin te/ zhes mtshams sbyar la/ slob dpon gyis/ rin po che la sogs pa'i snod phun sum sogs par dngos su bshams pa'i mchod pa rnams so so'i rig pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i/ lha rdzas kyi mchod yon/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri mchog /zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ār+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ nas/ shab+da'i bar sbyar bas byin gyis brlab/ de ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ dngos su bshams pa'i mchod pa rnams rgyur byas pa las byung ba'i lha rdzas kyi mchod pa'i sprin phung nam mkha'i khams khyab par gyur pa dang*/ gzhan yang 'jig rten gyi khams dpag tu med pa na yod pa'i me tog la sogs pa rnams/ bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la 'bul lo snyams pas 'di gsung bar zhu/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta (336)ār+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ḥ de bzhin du/ puṣ+pe nas/ shab+da 'i bar sbyar bas mchod du gzhug /spro na/ mchod yon phal cher sogs tshig bcad ji ltar rigs dang sbrel nas byas kyang rung ngo*/ /gnyis pa bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa ni// phyogs bcu rab 'byams mu mtha' med pa'i 'jig rten kyi khams ji snyed na/ bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i rin po che'i ri/ dpag bsam gyi shing*/ 'bru dang me tog /sman dang nags tshal la sogs pa thams cad rab tu dang ba'i blos blangs te sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la 'bul na/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad tshogs rdzogs pa'i don du khyed rnams kyis bzhes su gsol snyam pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

me tog 'bras bu ji snyed mchis pa dang*// sman gyi rnam pa gang dag yod pa dang*// 'jig rten rin chen ji snyed yod pa dang*// chu gtsang yid du 'ong ba ci yod dang*// rin chen ri bo dang ni de bzhin tu// nags tshal sa phyogs dben zhing nyams dga' dang*// ljon shing me tog rgyan spras spud pa dang*// shing gang 'bras bzang yal ga dud pa dang*// lha sogs 'jig rten na yang dri dang ni// spos dang dpag bsam shing dang rin chen shing*// ma rmos 'khrungs pa'i lo tog rnam pa gang*// gzhan yang mchod par 'os pa'i rgyan rnams ni// mtsho dang rdzing bu pad+mas brgyan pa dang*// ngang pa ra shin tu skad snyan yid 'ong ldan// nam mkhar rab 'byams khams kyi mthas gtugs pa// yongs su bzung ba med pa 'di dag kun// blo yis blangs nas thub pa skyes kyi mchog /sras dang bcas pa rnams la legs 'bul na// yon gnas dam pa thugs rje che rnams kyis// bdag la brtser dgongs bdag gi 'di dag bzhes// gsum pa lus 'bul pa ni// bdag gi lus 'di sangs rgyas dang byang chub (337)sems dpa' rnams kyi bran du phul nas/ de dag gi bya ba sems can gyi don 'ba' zhig bya snyams pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rgyal dang de sras rnams la bdag gis ni// bdag gi lus kun gtan du 'bul bar bgyi// sems dpa' mchog rnams bdag ni yongs bzhes shig /gus pas khyed kyi 'bangs su mchi bar bgyi// bzhi pa blos sprul pa'i mchod pa ni/ bdag gi tshig las byung ba'i khrus kyi khang pa zhes pa la sogs pa 'di rnams tshigs bcad las ji ltar byung ba'i rim pa bzhin du lam lam byung bar mos nas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la 'bul bar zhu/ zhes brda' sbyar nas rang gis tshig dal pa dod pa skabs phyed pas 'di rnams brjod par bya'o/ /khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa/ shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba bstar// rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan// mu tig 'od chags bla re bres pa der// de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni// rol mo bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol// de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la drir ba bsgos pas sku phyi'o// de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i// na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul// gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang*// rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag gis// 'phags pa kun tu bzang dang 'jam dbyangs dang*// 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs la'ang brgyan par bgyi// stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang pa yi// dri mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku// gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar// 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byugs par bgyi// thub dbang mchod gnas mchog la yid 'ong ba'i// me tog man+dā ra dang pad+ma dang*// ut+pal la sogs dri zhim thams cad dang*// phreng ba spel legs yid 'ong rnams kyis mchod// spos (338)mchog yid 'phrog dri ngang khyab pa yi/

bdug pa'i sprin tshogs rnams kyang de la dbul// zhal zas bza' btung sna tshogs bcas pa yi// lha bshos rnams kyang de la dbul bar bgyi// gser gyi pad+ma tshar du dngar ba yi// rin chen sgron me rnams kyang dbul bar bgyi// sa gzhi bstar ba spos chus byug pa der// me tog yid 'ong sil ma dgram par bya// gzhal med pho brang bstod dbyangs yid 'ong ldan// mu tig rin chen rgyan 'phyang mdzes 'bar ba// dpag yas nam mkha'i rgyan gyur de dag kyang*// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can la dbul bar bgyi// rin chen gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu ba can// 'khor yug rgyan gyi rnam pa yid 'ong ldan// dbyibs legs lta na sdug pa bsgreng ba yang*// rtag tu thub dbang rnams la dbul bar bgyi/ lnga pa mchod pa yongs su bsngo ba ni/ de dag las gzhan yang mchod pa'i bye brag mtha' klas pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa mnyes par byed cing*// sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byed pa'i tshogs nam mkha'i khams khyab par gnas shing mchod pa'i sprin gyi char chen po 'bab par gyur cig snyams pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs// rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan// sems can sdug bsngal sel byed pa'i// sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig /ces lan gcig dang*/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo bha ga wa te/ badz+ra sā ra pra mar dha ne/ ta tha ga ta ya ār+ha te/ samya k+saṃ bud+dha ya// tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re ma hā badz+re ma hā te dzo badz+re/ ma hā bid+yā badz+re/ ma hā bid+yā bodhiṃ tsit+ta badz+re/ ma hā bodhi maṇ+ḍo pa saṃ kra ma ṇa badz+ra/ sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na badz+re swā hā/ zhes mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs len gsum brjod du gzhug go /de nas skabs 'dir gtor ma 'bul bar spro na/ de rnams kyis mchod pa'i yan lag dngos gzhi grub nas/ rjes 'brel du gtor ma 'bul ba ci slob dpon gyis bgyi bar gda' ste/

zhes mtshams sbyar la/ gtor ma rnams (339)la chab bran/ slob dpon gyis/ rin po che la sogs pa'i gtor snod kyi nang du gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i ngo bor gyur pa'i gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang bar gyur/ oṃ a kā ra ོ sogs lan gsum gyis brlabs nas/ gtor ma dang po/ oṃ sarba gu ru bud+dha dharma saṅga sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs btags pa gsum mam lngas bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phul nas/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi rgyud la byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems rin po che bcos ma ma yin pa skye ba dang*/ skyes pa gong nas gong du 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma gnyis pa/ oṃ dharma pā la sa pa ri wa ra oṃ a kā ro sogs btags pa len gsum gyis chos skyong spyi la phul nas/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po la sogs pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams dang*/ dkar phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i lha klu gnod sbyin 'byung po'i tshogs rnams mchod sbyin gyis gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang*/ bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi rgyud la byang chub kyi sems rin po che mi nyams shing gong nas gong du 'phel ba dang*/ bar chad thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las dang sdong grogs mdzad du gsol/ /zhes 'dod don gsol/ gtor ma gsum pa/ gnyug mar gnas pa'i gzhi'i bdag po rnams mdun du mngon sum bzhin 'khod par bsam la/ oṃ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs btags pa lan gsum gyi bsngos la/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di gzhi bdag /gnas bdag /grong bdag /dkor bdag /gnyug mar gnas pa rnams la 'bul lo// mchod do// stob bo// bzhes shig

/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams su bde legs thams cad 'byung ba dang*/ (340)bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyis byang chub kyi sems rin po che bskyed pa la dga' zhing rjes su yi rang nas/ bar du gcod pa thams cad srung ba'i stong grogs dam pa mdzod cig

/ces phrin las gzhol/ gsum pa sdig pa bshags pa ni/ rang gzhan thams cad kyis rgyu dug gsum gyis kun nas bslangs shing*/ byed pa po sgo gsum dang rjes su 'brel pas sngar bsags pa'i sdig ltung thams cad dran yal du byas nas de la 'gyod pa drag po bskyed pa dang*/ da phyin chad srog la bab kyang sdig pa mi byed snyams pa'i zhe bcad chen po dang*/ da ni gzhan don du sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i phyir rten dkon mchog gsum la brten nas sdig pa'i gnyen po'i chos rnams tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bya'o snyam pa'i bsam pa zhe thag pa'i sgo nas sdig bshags kyi tshig brjod pas sdig pa thams cad sangs sangs dag pa'i mos pa dang bcas te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni// lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid kyis kyang*// sdig pa bdag gis bgyis pa ci mchis pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis so sor bshags// bzhi pa dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba ni// 'phags pa dang so so skye bo'i bde ba dang dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la zhe thag pa nas dga' ba'i bsam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang sangs rgyas sras// rang rgyal rnams dang slob dang mi slob dang*// 'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams gang la yang*// de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag yi rang*// lnga pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba ni/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang dag sangs rgyas nas zhu ba po'i tshogs rdzogs par bya ba la sogs pa'i don du chos kyi 'khor lo mi bskor ba'ang yod pas/ de rnams la gdul bya rnams kyi don du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar zhu snyam pa'i bsam (341)pa zhe thag pas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gang rnams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sgron ma dag /byang chub rim par sangs rgyas ma chags brnyes// mgon po de dag bdag gis thams cad la// 'khor lo bla na med pa bskor bar bskul/

drug pa mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa ni/ gang dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na/ sangs rgyas 'ga' zhig sangs rgyas la dkon mchog pa'i 'du shes bskyed pa la sogs pa'i don du mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ston par bzhed pa'ang yod pas/ de rnams la zhing de rnams kyi gdul bya'i don du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar yun ring du bzhugs su gsol snyam pa'i bsam pa zhe thag pas mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// mya ngan 'da' ston gang bzhed de dag la// 'gro ba kun la phan zhing bde ba'i phyir// bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed bzhugs par yang*// bdag gis thal mo rab sbyar gsol bar bgyi/ bdun pa bsngo ba ni/ de ltar phyag 'tshal ba la sogs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa bas mtshon dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal sel ba dang*/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba thams cad 'grub pa'i rgyur byang chub chen por yongs su bsngo bar bgyi'o snyams pa'i yid kyis 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang*// rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yi// dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa// thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir bsngo'o// de rnams kyis sbyor ba'i rim pa grub nas/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ ji skad du/ de la dang po'i rigs nus las// snying rje'i sa bon rab sad cing*// sbyor dang bsam pa phun tshogs pas// byang chub sems ni yongs su bzung*/ zhes 'byung bas/ sems bskyed de (342)rang stobs dang*/ gzhan stobs dang*/ sbyor ba'i stobs las skye ba las/ dang po ni/ rang la theg chen gyi rigs yod pa yin te/ khyed rnams la byang chub tu sems bskyed par 'dod pa'i blo byung bas de yod par grub/ gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dang byang chub kyi sems kyi phan yon thos pa dang*/

theg chen gyi chos la thos bsam sgom gsum byas pa la sogs pas skye ba yin te/ de dag kyang ci rigs par tshang*/ gsum pa ni/ bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes dang*/ rang la rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu'i 'du shes/ sems can thams cad la byams pa dang snying rje'i 'du shes byed pa ste/ dang po ni/ bla ma 'dis bdag la sangs rgyas kyi rgyu'i gtso bo byang chub kyi sems bskyed par byed pas na sangs rgyas dngos yin snyam pa bya/ de ltar sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes skyes na shin tu legs/ de ma skyes na lang sems bskyed kyi slob dpon du 'os pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yin snyams pa'i bsam pa nges par bskyed dgos so// gnyis pa ni// phung po lnga la bdag ces btags shing blo 'khrul pas bdag tu bzung ba ma gtogs bdag bden par ma grub pas sgyu ma'am rmi lam lta bu yin snyam du bsam mo// gsum pa ni/ dbu ma snying po las/ byams pa dang ni snying rje dang*// shes rab chen pos brgyan pa yi// sangs rgyas sa bon byang chub sems// de phyir mkhas pas de mi btang*// zhes pa dang*/ mdo sde rgyan las/ de yi rtsa ba snying rjer 'dod/ ces pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi mdo sde las/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa'i byang chub tu mngon par mos pa'i sngon du 'gro ba ni snying rje chen po yin no// zhes gsungs pas 'di ltar nges par bya ste/ mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyis thog ma med pa nas lan grangs dpag tu med par bdag gi ma byas shing gnod pa las bskyabs/ phan pa bsgrubs/ rang bas kyang gces pa'i (343)'du shes kyis/ rang gi sdig pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad khyad du bsad nas nga la phan pa sna tshogs byas/ nga bde ba dang ldan zhing bde ba dang me 'bral ba'i don du tsha grang bkres skom ngal dub la sogs pa dang ldan pa'i 'bad rtsol chen po grangs med par byas shing*/ nga na ba dang 'chi ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal ma bzod nas ngus pa'i mchi ma bsags kyang rgya mtsho chen po bas kyang lhag pa yod de/

de ltar gnod pa las bzlog cing phan pa bsgrub pas 'di rnams shin tu drin che snyam du legs par bsams la/ 'di rnams gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba ldan na ci ma rung snyams pa dang*/ de la bdag gis dgod par bya'o snyam pa'i byams pa dang*/ 'di rnams bde bar 'dod kyang sdug bsngal dang ldan te/ dmyal ba la tsha grang*/ yi dwags la bkres skom/ dud 'gro la gcig la gcig za ba la sogs pa dang*/ mi la'ang skye rga na 'chi la sogs pa dang*/ lha ma yin la 'thab rtsod la sogs pa dang*/ 'dod khams kyi lha la 'chi ltas la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod la/ khams gong ma dag tu'ang de las nyams nas dmyal ba la sogs par skye bar 'gyur bas mtshon sdug bsngal kho na las ma 'das pa'i tshul/ mdo dran pa nyer bzhag las/ sems can dmyal ba dmyal mes nyams// yi dwags bkres shing skam pas nyams/ dud 'gro gcig la gcig zas nyams// mi dag 'tsho ba thung bas nyams// lha dag bag med pa yis nyams// 'khor ba khab kyi rtse tsam la// bde ba nam yang yod ma yin// zhes dang*/ gzhan yang mdo las/ 'dod pa'i khams kyang skyon dang bcas pa ste// gzugs kyi khams kyang skyon dang bcas pa'o// de bzhin gzugs med khams kyang skyon mang bcas/ zhes dang*/ 'dul ba lung las/ sred srid ma rig dbang gis skye bo rnams// mi dang lha dang ngan song rnam gsum ste// 'gro ba lnga po (344)dag tu mi mkhas 'khor/ dper na rdza mkhan 'khor lo 'khor ba bzhin// srid gsum rga dang nad kyi sdug bsngal 'bar// 'di na 'chi me rab 'bar mgon med de// srid las byung la 'gro ba rtag tu rmongs// bum par chud pa'i bung pa 'khor ba bzhin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mdor na gnas khams gsum du rten rigs drug gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dang*/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal kho nas dus rtag tu sdug bsngal bar 'gyur ba'i sems can de dag sdug bsngal de las thar bar 'dod kyang*/

las dang nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba dam pos bcings/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis ma zin/ thar par 'gro ba'i grogs bzang po dang bral/ 'phags pa rnams kyi gdul byar yang ma gyur pas sdug bsngal las thar pa'i thabs mi 'dug pas re snying rje snyam du sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal rang thog tu babs pa tsam du bsam la/ 'di rnams sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa thams cad dang bral na ci ma rung*/ de dang bral bar bdag gis bya'o snyam pa'i snying rje drag tu bsgoms pa dang*/ de ltar 'di rnams bde ba la dgod cing sdug bsngal thams cad las sgrol ba'i khur ngal bab cing spro yang da lta de'i nus pa med par ma zad/ de bas lhag pa'i tshangs pa dang brgya byin/ de bas lhag pa'i nyan rang dgra bcom pa la sogs pa la yang med/ de ltar sus nus na don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kho nas nus pas de thob par bya/ de'i rgyu'i gtso bo sems bskyed yin pas de blang par bya snyam du zhe thag pa nas bsam la/ sems bskyed nas de la bslab bya rnams la bslab pas bdag gis gdon mi za bar sangs rgyas thob des/ de thob nas sems can rnams sdug bsngal gyi chu bo las bsgral/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba las sgrol/ gnas skabs su sdug bsngal las dbugs dbyung ba/ mthar thug mya ngan las bzla snyam du bsam (345)la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar thub pa chen po la sogs pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa mngon sum du bzhugs par mos pa dang bcas te dgongs su gsol zhes brjod/ brjod pa'i tshe 'di rnams kyi ye shes dang thugs rjes nges par gzigs snyam du bsam pa shugs drag tu bskyed/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lhang sa la btsugs pa'i tsog pur 'dug ste/ thal mo sbyar nas don dran bzhin pas sems rtse gcig tu byas te/ cho ga 'di rnams kyi rjes su bzlas pa lan gsum gyi sgo nas sems bskyed dgos pas rjes zlos dang po gnang bar zhu/

phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ so so rang rang gi ming nas smos te/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas skye ba gzhan dang gzhan dag tu sbyin pa'i rang bzhin dang*/ tshul khrims kyi rang bzhin dang sgom pa'i rang bzhin gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba ci bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du stsal ba dang*/ bgyis pa la rjes su yi rangs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang*/ sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen por sems bskyed par bgyi'o// sems can ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi'o// ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi'o// dbugs ma dbyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o// yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las bzla bar bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gcig brjod du gzhug / des rjes (346)zlos dang po song nas/ gnyis pa dang gsum pa'ang lan re re zhing blo sbyong zhing bya bar gsungs pas na bsam pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ nam mkha' la mtha' med pa bzhin sems can gyi khams la'ang mtha' med/ mtha' med pa'i sems can re res kyang rang nyid kyi pha ma grangs med pa byas shing byas res bzhin du da lta'i pha ma dang mtshungs par phan pa tshad med pa btags/ gnod pa las ci nus kyis bskyabs pa'i drin can sha stag yin pas bdag gis kyang de rnams la drin bzo ba'i slad du phan pa bsgrub cing*/ gnod pa las zlog par bya/ de yang gang gis phan na bde bas dngos su phan zhing*/

dge bas brgyud nas phan pa'i phyir ma drin can 'di rnams bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur na ci ma rung snyams pa'i byams pa dang*/ sdug bsngal gyis dngos su gnod cing sdig pas brgyud nas gnod pa'i phyir sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur na ci ma rung snyam pa'i snying rje dang tshul de thams cad kyang bdag kho nas bgyi'o snyam du khur khyer ba lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa sngon du 'gro bas/ de ltar sems can thams cad phan bde mtha' dag la dgod nus pa ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa kho na la rag las pa'i phyir/ bdag gis kyang ma rgan sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang de ci nas kyang thob nges pa zhig bya/ de yang rgyu med rkyen med las mi 'byung bas/ rgyu rkyen gyi gtso bo rnam pa kun tu dge ba'i rtsa ba ji snyed cig bsags pa'i mthu la brten nas byang chub kyi sems rin po che bskyed cing rgyal ba'i sras kyi lam las rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu thob par byas te/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gyi chu gter las bsgral zhing kun 'byung gi 'ching ba las sgrol ba dang*/ srid pa'i khams las dbugs dbyung zhing mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa chen por dgod par bgyi'o (347)snyam pa'i mos pa shugs drag tu bskyed cing tshig tu brjod pa na rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i ye shes gzigs pa dam pas mngon sum du mkhyen nges snyams pa'i dad gus kyi sems rtse gcig pa dang bcas pas rjes zlos gnyis pa mdzad par zhu/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i/ nas/ bzla bar bgyi'o// bar lan gcig /slar yang 'di ltar nges par bya ste/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la tshad med pa'i mos gus bskyed pa sngon du 'gro bas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad don dam par bden par ma grub kyang*/

kun rdzob tu nga dang nga yir 'dzin pa'i dbang gis sgyu ma dang rmi lam ltar bde sdug sna tshogs pa nyams su myong ba'i skabs 'dir/ bde ba 'dod cing sdug bsngal mi 'dod par rnam pa kun tu mtshungs pas na/ gnas skabs su bdag gi bde ba dang dge ba'i rtsa ba ci mchis pa rnams mar gyur drin can thams cad la phongs pa med par gtong zhing*/ de rnams kyi sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas par rang nyid kyis dang du blangs par bgyi'o snyams pa dang*/ mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya ba dang*/ sems can thams cad la re re zhing phan pa dang bde ba mtha' dag bsgrub par bgyi/ de'i ched du rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam byang chub kyi sems rin po che bskyed par bgyi'o snyams pa ste/ mdor na bla ma dang dkon mchog la dad pa chen po dang*/ sems can la brtse ba chen po dang*/ sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi 'dun pa chen po ste chen po gsum dang ldan pa'i sgo nas rjes zlos gsum pa 'di shin tu gal che ba lags pas bshad pa brda 'phrod pa dang*/ dam bca'i tshig rnams ngal zhing dod la skabs phyed pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i nas/ bzla bar bgyi'o/ /bar lan gcig / des khyed rnams kyi rgyud la byang chub tu smon pa'i sems khyad par can skye ba yin pas skyes nges snyam (348)pa'i thob shis kyi dga' ba bskyed par zhu/ gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga la gsum las/ dang po sems gzengs bstod pa ni/ bdag gis thog ma med pa nas lus dpag tu med pa blangs kyang*/ don chen po ma grub pas 'khor bar lus pa yin pa la/ da res rang gzhan thams cad kyi phan bde'i rgyu gcig pu byang chub kyi sems rin po che rgyud la skyes pas/ dal 'byor gyi rton 'tsho ba dang bcas pa don yod cing*/ rgyal ba'i sras su gyur pas don thams cad grub snyams pa dang*/ ji ltar 'byung ba'i tshig rnams kyi don la yang legs par sems shing dga' spro khyad par can bskyed bzhin pa'i ngang nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/
deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod// mi yi srid pa legs par thob// de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skye// sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to/

/zhes lan gcig brjod du gzhug / gnyis pa bslab bya bstan pa la rnam pa lnga yod pa ni/ tshig 'di rnams la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ de yang dang po yang dang yang du sems bskyed par gdams pa ni/ mdo las/ khyod la bsgo zhing khong du chud par bya// ji ltar ji ltar mang du mis brtags na// de la gnas pa'i rnam par rtog pa des// de lta de ltar de la sems gzhol 'gyur// zhes gsungs shing*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen shar ba'i zhal nas kyang*/ byang chub kyi sems ting nge 'dzin du ci 'ong bya/ theg chen bsam gtan gyi dmigs pa yang 'di kho na yin gsung skad/ des na yan lag bdun pa dang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi cho ga rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa'i sgo nas yang dang yang du sems bskyed cing*/ byang chub kyi sems 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir tha na'ang nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa 'di dag gis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pas zhe (349)thag pa nas sems bskyed par bya'o// gnyis pa tshogs gnyis bsags pa la bslab pa ni/ stong pa nyid dang snying rje zung du 'brel ba'i blos sbyin pa la sogs pa'i dge ba la myur du 'bad par bya ste/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ dge ba thams cad la tshul sna tshogs nas 'bad par bya zhing 'phral thams cad mkhyen par bsngo/ de ltar byas na bsod nams kyang ye shes dang*/ ye shes kyang bsod nams kyi tshogs su 'gro bas tshogs gnyis tha mi dad du bya ste/ thams cad mkhyen pa tshogs gnyis kyi 'bras bu yin pas so// zhes gsung skad/ gsum pa chos bzhi'i spangs blang la bslab pa ni/ byang chub kyi sems nyams par byed pa'i chos bzhi spangs nas/ mi nyams par byed pa'i chos bzhi la slob par byed pa yin te/ de dag kyang spang gnyen du bla ma rnams bzhed pas/

de la bla ma dang mchod par 'os pa bslu ba ni/ ltung ba gleng ba na byung bzhin du ma byung zhes smra ba'am/ dge ba bsgrub pa'i nas pa yod bzhin du med ces pa lta bu rdzun gyis bslu ba yin la/ de'i gnyen por srog gi phyir yang bsam bzhin du rdzun mi smra ba la bslab par bya'o// gzhan 'gyod pa'i gnas ma yin pa la 'gyod pa bskyed pa ni/ spyir dge ba la zhugs pa dang*/ khyad par du theg pa chen po la zhugs pa la 'gyod pa bskyed pa yin te/ de'i gnyen por sems can 'ga' zhig dge ba la dgod pa de dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la 'god kyi/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sa la ma yin no// zhes pa'i don la bslab par bya'o// sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la zhe sdang gis tshigs su bcad pa ma yin pa brjod pa'i gnyen por/ sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed cing phyogs bcur yang dag pa ri yon tan brjod pa la bslab par bya ste/ chos thams cad 'byung ba med par bstan pa las/ nyin dang de bzhin (350)mtshan mo lan gsum du// byang chub sems dpa' rnams la mgos phyag 'tshal// rtag tu 'dod bzhin spyad pa spyod pa na// de dag 'khrul pa tsam yang mi btsal lo// zhes gsungs pa ltar bya'o// sems can thams cad la sgyu dang g.yos spyod pa'i gnyen bor/ sems can thams cad la lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pas gnas par bya yi/ g.yo dang sgyu ma yin pa la bslab par bya'o/ lhag pa'i bsam pa ni/ sems can thams cad phan bde la sbyor bar 'dod pa'o// bzhi pa sems can blos mi spang ba la bslab pa ni/ sems can khyu ril du spangs pa ni sems can gyi skyon mthong ba'am/ theg chen gyi lam sgrub dka' ba la sogs pa'i rgyus gzhan don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi blos spangs ba ste/ de byung na thar pa gtan mi 'dod dam nyan rang gi thar pa 'dod kyang rung*/

smon 'jug gnyis ka gtong ste/ mdo sdud pa las/ gal te bskal pa bye bar dge ba'i las lam bcu// spyod kyang rang rgyal dgra bcom nyid la 'dod byed na// de tshe tshul khrims skyon byung tshul khrims nyams pa yin// sems bskyed de ni phas pham bas kyang shin tu lci/ zhes gsungs so// nyi tshe ba spong ba ni/ sems can 'gal zhig la bdag gis phan gdags dgos shing nus kyang mi gdags snyams du blos 'dor ba ste/ des kyang sems can la dmigs pa'i sems bskyed gtong bas thun tshod kyi nang du gang blos spangs ba de phan sems kyis blos bzung la/ de la dngos su phan ma thogs kyang rang gi blo ma gnod par bya gsung*/ des na/ gzhan phan las la mthu med kyang*// de yi bsam pa rtag tu bya// gang la bsam pa de yod pa// de ni de la don gyis zhugs// zhes pas sems can thams cad la phan sems bskyed par bya'o// lnga pa byang chub sems kyi phan yon dran par bya ba ni/ sdong po bkod pa'i mdo las/ byang chub kyi sems ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi sa bon lta bu'o// zhes (351)dang*/ mdor na sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan ji snyed yod pa/ byang chub sems kyi phan yon yang de snyed do// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad 'di las byung ste/ 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar 'byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyang 'di las skyes so// zhes gsungs pa la sogs pa'i phan yon rnams yang dang yang du dran par bya'o// gzhan yang gzhung las// khyad par du mngon par shes pa myur du thob par 'dod pas byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis zhus pa'i chos bdun pa zhes bya ba'i theg pa chen po'i mdo la bslab par bya'o// zhes 'byung bas// mdo de'i don/ rnam rtog gis kyang 'dod pa mi bsten na/ dbang po gnyis sprod pa lta ci smos shing rmi lam du'ang mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen la mi bsten pa dang*/

bya dang 'dra bar sems kyis yongs su 'dzin pa med pa dang*/ thabs shes gnyis la mkhas kyang nga rgyal med pa dang*/ dngos por 'dzin pa spangs nas stong nyid kyi rnam thar brten par bya ba dang*/ yang dag par bden pa ma yin pas sgyu ma dang 'dra ba'i shes pas spyad pa dang*/ sems can la lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pas gnas pa dang*/ rgyu dang 'bras bu la skur pa mi gdab pa ste chos bdun po de bstan pas de dag la bslab par bya'o// yang*/ nag po'i chos bzhi dang*/ sems can blos spongs pa'i ltung ba byung nas nyin zhag gcig gi drug cha'i thun tshod las 'das na sems bskyed gtong bas bshags bsdams byas la slar blang*/ thun tshod kyi nang du gnyen po skyes na bshags dus snga phyi 'dra zhing*/ bshags yul byang chub sems dpa' 'am/ ma rnyed na so thar gyi dge bsnyen yan chad kyi mdun du ltung ba 'di byung ste zhes dngos po brjod nas bshags par bya gsungs so// smon pa sems (352)bskyed kyi skor 'di rgyal ba byams pa nas jo bo'i bar du snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'i gdams pa kho na las byon pa yin/ 'di'i blo sbyong dang*/ cho ga dang*/ bslab bya dang bcas pa 'di gzhung gzhan na mi bzhugs pas 'di dang skyabs 'gro kho na jo bo bod la bka' drin che ba yin/ des na smon pa sems bskyed skor dang bcas pa 'di jo bo'i gdams ngag rnams kyi mchog tu gyur pa yin no gsungs shing*/ 'di la slob ma'ang nges pa med pas thams cad la gnang ba lags/ gsum pa gtong rag gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ de ltar byang chub kyi sems skyes pa de bla ma dang dkon mchog gi bka' drin yin pas/ de'i drin lan du sngar sbyor ba'i skabs su ji skad bshad pa'i dmigs pa rnams yid la dran bzhin pas dngos su bshams pa'i mchod pa dang*/ lus dbul ba'i mchod pa dang*// de las gzhan yang blos sprul pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pa rnams rim bzhin du 'bul bar zhu/

zhes brda sbyar la/ dngos su bshams pa'i mchod pa rnams kha gsos la/ slob dpon gyis sbyor ba'i skabs ltar byin gyis brlab nas/ dpon slob thun mong du/ oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ lus 'bul ba'i mchod pa/ rgyal dang de sras rnams la bdag gis ni/ sogs sho lo ka gcig dang*/ gzhan yang*/ me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang*/ sogs sh+tso ka gsum rnams tshar re brjod du gzhug go / de ltar na de rnams kyi sgo nas smon pa sems bskyed kyi cho ga yan lag dang bcas pa legs par phul grub nas/ gnyis pa 'jug pa'i sems bskyed ni byang chub sems dpa'i sa las/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa nas gsungs shing*/ de'i cho ga yang gsal por gsungs pa bzhin du/ jo bo chen pos cho ga'i gzhung mdzad pa'i tshul ltar 'dir sdom pa 'bog pa'i cho ga la gsum/ len pa po'i gang zag /blang ba'i yul/ blang ba'i cho ga'o// de la dang po len po'i gang zag ni/ smon pa'i sems skyes shing byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa tshul khrims gsum la nges par slob par 'dod pa'i 'dun pa dang (353)ldan ba ste/ byang sa las/ de la byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa'am/ rab tu byung ba byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa tshul khrims kyi phung po rnam pa gsum po 'di dag la bslab par 'dod cing*/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu smon lam btab pas zhes gsungs shing*/ so so thar pa rigs bdun gang rung gi sdom pa dang ldan dgos te/ jo bos/ so sor thar pa rigs bdun gyi// rtag tu sdom gzhan ldan pa la// byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yi// skal ba yod kyi gzhan du min/ zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa gang las blang ba'i yul ni/ rang nyid byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang ldan zhing*/ sdom pa'i cho ga la mkhas pa/ slob mas go bar nus pa'i tshig gi sgo nas sdom pa 'bogs par nus pa ste/ sdom pa nyi shu pa las// bla ma sdom la gnas shing mkhas// nus dang ldan las blang bar bya// zhes gsungs so// gsum pa ji ltar blang ba'i tshul la sbyor ba/

dngos gzhi/ mjug gi cho ga'o// dang po la'ang lnga/ gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ bsam pa brtag pa dang*/ myur du sbyin par gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ bar chad dri ba dang*/ bslab pa'i gnas go bar byas nas spro ba dri ba'o// dang po gsol ba gdab pa la/ thog mar slob dpon la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed nas phyag gsum mdzad par zhu/ zhes phyag gsum 'tshal du gzhug / de nas 'jug pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i sdom pa zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ zhes par sbyar la maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug / de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ phyag snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ slob dpon khyod las bdag byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blang ba len par 'tshal gyis/ de la gnod pa ma mchis na bdag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du cung zad cig gsan cing stsal ba'i rigs so// lan gsum/ (354)gnyis pa bsam pa brtag pa la gsum las/ dang po blo rtsal la brtag pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa len pa la ngas mi 'grub pa'am/ mi nus pa gang yang med snyam pa'i blo rtsal dgos pas/ snod du byed pa'i chos bzhi brjod la brtag par bya bar gsungs pas nged kyis dris pa'i tshig 'di rnams la lan drangs por thob mdzod/ ces brda sbyar la slob dpon gyis/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpas sems can thams cad smin par byed dgos la/ de la bslab pa grangs med pa la bslab dgos na/ sems can thams cad smin par byed pa'i bslab pa rnams la slob par nus sam/ zhes dris la/ slob mas/ nus lags/ zhes brjod pas khas blang ngo*// de bzhin du/ slob dpon gyis/ byang chub sems dpa' zhing khams grangs med pa sbyong ba dang*/ sangs rgyas grangs med pa mnyes par bya dgos na/ zhing khams grangs med pa sbyang ba dang sangs rgyas grangs med pa mnyes par byed pa la slob par nus sam/

zhes dris la/ slob mas nus lags zhes brjod pas bas blang ngo*// slob dpon gyis/ byang sems kyi sdom pa de nyams na sems can thams cad bde ba la 'god par dam bcas nas de dag thams cad bslus par 'gyur te/ ji skad du/ spyod 'jug las/ dngos po phal pa cung zad la'ang*// yid kyis sbyin zhes bsam byas nas// mi gang sbyin par mi byed pa// de yang yi dwags rgyur gsungs na// bla na med pa'i bde ba la// bsam pa thag pas mgron gnyer nas// 'gro ba thams cad bslus byas na// bde 'gror ci ga 'gror 'gyur ngam/ zhes gsungs pas// sems can thams cad bslus ba'i rnam smin gyis dmyal ba la sogs par skye bar 'gyur ba'i nyes dmigs chen po yod na/ nyes dmigs des mi 'jigs sam/ zhes dris pa la/ nyams na nyes dmigs che yang ma nyams pa byas pas chog snyam du go ba bskyed la lan thob mdzod/ ces brjod la/ slob mas/ mi 'jigs (355)lags/ zhes brjod cing khas blang ngo*// yang slob dpon gyis/ bslab pa de ma nyams par bsrungs na/ spyod 'jug las/ gang nas bzung ste sems can khams// mtha' yas rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir// mi ldog pa yi sems kyis su// sems de yang dag blangs gyur pa/ deng nas bzung ste gnyid log gam// bag med gyur kyang bsod nams shugs// rgyun mi 'chad pa du ma zhig /nam mkha' mnyam pa rab tu 'byung*/ zhes gsungs pa ltar bsod nams rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung ba la sogs pa'i phan yon chen po yod na phan yon chen po de thob par 'dod pas bslab pa de la slob par spro'am/ zhes dris pa la/ slob mas/ spro lags/ zhes brjod pas khas blang ngo*// gnyis pa shes rab la brtag pa ni/ slob dpon gyis/ rigs kyi bu/ zhes brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas/ slob ma so so'i ming nas smos la/ ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod kyis byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi ma mo thos sam/ zhes dris la/ slob mas/

cung zad thos so// zhes lan btab/ de bzhin du/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi ma mo shes sam/ zhes dris la/ cung zad shes so// zhes lan btab/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi ma mo la dad dam/ zhes dris la/ shin tu dad do*/ /zhes lan btab/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi ma mo las gsungs pa'i bslab pa'i gzhi rnams pa srung bar nus sam/ zhes dris la/ bsrung bar nus lags/ ces khas blang du gzhug go /gsum pa 'dun pa la brtag pa ni/ thog mar 'di ltar nges par bya ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la brten nas/ bdag nyid sangs rgyas thob cing sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las sgrol ba la sogs pa'i yon tan dpag tu med pa dang ldan pas de la 'jug par bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa rtse gcig tu bskyed la nged kyis dris pa'i tshig 'di rnams la lan thob mdzod/ zhes brda sbyar la/ slob dpon gyis/ rigs kyi bu khyod nyon cig /khyod 'di (356)ltar sems can ma bsgral rnams bsgral ba dang*/ ma grol ba rnam dgrol ba dang*/ dbugs ma phyin pa rnams dbugs dbyung ba dang*/ yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams mya ngan las bzla ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi gdung rgyun mi 'chad par 'dod dam/

zhes dris la/ slob mas/ 'dod lags/ ces lan btab pa la/ slob dpon gyis/ de la khyed kyis sems bskyed brtan pa dang*/ yi dam brtan par bya'o/ /zhes gdams/ yang slob dpon gyis/ gzhan dang 'gran pa'i ched du ma yin nam/ zhes dris la/ slob mas / ma yin lags/ ces lan btab/ gzhan gyis nan gyis lan du bcug pa ma yin nam/ zhes dris la/ ma yin lags/ ces lan btab bo/ /gsum pa myur du sbyin par gsol ba gdab pa la/ mchod pa 'bul ba phyag 'tshal ba sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas gsol ba gdab par gsungs pas/ thog mar bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po la sogs pa'i phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar mngon sum lta bur bzhugs par bsam la/ de rnams kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan tshad med pa rjes su dran pas dang 'dod yid ches kyi dad pa shugs drag tu bskyed bzhin pa'i ngang*/ dngos su bshams pa'i mchod pa dang*/ lus dbul ba'i mchod pa dag rim bzhin du gnang bar zhu/ zhes brda sbyar la/ mchod pa gsar du bshams pa rnams slob dpon gyis sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs/ de nas dpon slob thun mong du/ mchod phreng tshigs bcad dang bcas rgyas par bya ba'am/ bsdu na/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pūṣ+pe nas/ shab+da'i bar sbyar ba dang*/ /rgyal dang de sras rnams la bdag gis ni/ sogs sh+lo ka gcig brjod du gzhug /slob dpon la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed de phyag gsum mdzad par zhu/ zhes phyag gsum 'tshal zin pa dang*/ rang rang gi gral la tsog pur 'khod de phyag snyim pa me tog dang bcas (357)pas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ slob dpon gyis byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blang ba bdag la myur du stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ bzhi pa bar chad dri ba ni/

sdom pa'i rten du byang sems kyi rigs la gnas shing smon pa'i sems skyes pa dgos pas de lta bu'i rigs can yin nam zhes dris pa 'di la lan thob mdzod/ rigs kyi bu/ ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod byang chub sems dpa' yin nam/ zhes dris la/ yin lags/ zhes lan btab/ byang chub tu smon lam btab bam/ zhes dris la/ btab lags/ ces lan btab bo/ /lnga pa bslab pa'i gnas go bar bya zhing spro ba dri ba la/ dang por bslab pa'i gnas go bar bya ba ni/ mi zad pa dpag tu med pa bla na med pa'i bsod nams kyi gter/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa myur du thob par 'gyur ro snyam du dga' ba khyad par can bskyed pa dang bcas tshig 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ mi dge ba mtha' dag spong ba'i sems pa sa bon dang bcas pa sdom pa'i tshul khrims/ phar phyin drug la sogs pa'i dge ba sgrub 'dod kyi sems pa sa bon dang bcas pa dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims/ sems can thams cad kyi don byed par 'dod pa'i sems pa sa bon dang bcas pa sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims yin zhing*/ de dag dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bslab pa'i gzhi dang tshul khrims yin no// zhes go ba bskyed nas/ de lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i gzhi rnams dang*/ tshul khrims de dag bdag las len par 'dod dam/ zhes spro ba dris pa 'di la lan thob mdzod/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bslab pa'i gzhi rnams dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi tshul khrims de dag ci bdag (358)las len par 'dod dam/ zhes dris la/ slob mas/ len pa rang tshal lo/ /zhes lan btab/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ spyir bslab pa nod par lan gsum du khas blangs pa nyid kyis sdom pa skye ba yin na'ang*/ thog mar bsam pa 'di ltar nges pa gal che ste/ chos thams cad don dam par yod med la sogs pa spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral zhing*/

kun rdzob tu/ mdo ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po las/ sgyu ma byed pa dag gis gzugs sprul te// rta dang glang po shing rta sna tshogs byas// de la ji bzhin snang ba gang yang med// chos rnams thams cad de 'drar shes par gyis// zhes gsungs pa ltar snang ba thams cad snang yang bden pa med par shes par byas nas/ de lta bu'i don ma rtogs par/ gzung 'dzin la bden par zhen pa'i dbang gis khams gsum gyi 'khor ba'i gnas su bde ba 'dod bzhin du bde ba dang ni bral/ sdug bsngal mi 'dod bzhin du sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ni ldan/ bde ba sgrub cing sdug bsngal 'dor ba'i thabs mi shes pa'i rigs drug gi sems can thams cad kyis thog ma med pa nas yang nas yang du bdag gi pha ma byas te/ phan bde sgo du ma nas ni bsgrubs/ gnod 'tshe thams cad las ni ci nus kyis bskyabs/ bsam rgyu dang dran rgyu ni bdag las med pa byas shing*/ bdag gi ched du lus srog kyang grangs med par btang pa'i drin can sha stag yin pas/ de thams cad sdug bsngal las bsgral zhing bde ba la 'god par bya dgos na'ang*/ da lta bdag la de'i nus pa med cing*/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal la sgrol zhing bde ba la 'god nus pa sangs rgyas kho na yin pas de bdag gis thob par bya/ de'ang rgyu med par mi thob cing*/ de'i rgyu'i gtso bo ni byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yin pas/ de bdag gis blangs nas/ bslab pa gsum ka yul thams cad du/ dus thams cad kyi tshe tshe rabs rabs thams cad du bsrung (359)bar bya snyam du bsam nas/ bla ma la sangs rgyas dang*/ rang la sgyu ma lta bur shes pa dang ldan pas/ sems rtse gcig tu gyis la lan thob mdzod/ ces brjod nas/ slob dpon gyis/ rigs kyi bu/ ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod/ bdag byang chub sems dpa' slob dpon rang nyid kyi ming nas smos la ming 'di zhes bya ba las/ 'das pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bslab pa'i gzhir gyur ba gang yin pa dang*/

tshul khrims su gyur ba gang yin pa dang*/ ma byon pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bslab pa'i gzhir gyur pa gang yin pa dang*/ tshul khrims su gyur pa gang yin pa dang*/ da ltar phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bslab pa'i gzhir gyur pa gang yin pa dang*/ tshul khrims su gyur pa gang yin pa'i bslab pa'i gzhi gang dag dang*/ tshul khrims gang dag la 'das pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bslabs par gyur pa dang*/ ma byon pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad slob par 'gyur ba dang*/ phyogs bcu dag na da ltar bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad da ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i gzhi thams cad dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims thams cad de sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ dge ba'i chos sdud pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ sems can gyi don byed pa'i tshul khrims rnams nod dam/ zhes brjod la/ slob mas/ nod lags/ zhes pas blang ngo*/ /des bas blangs pa dang po song nas/ lan re re bzhin blo sbyong bsgom zhing bya bar gsungs pas bsam pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mtha' yas pa'i mar gyur sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan zhing sdug bsngal las sgrol ba'i slad du bdag gis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che de ci nas kyang thob pa zhig bya/ de yang rgyu med rkyen med pa las mi 'byung bas/ rgyu rkyen gyi gtso bo dus (360)gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs la 'byon par 'gyur ba'i rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bslab par bya ba'i gzhi/ tshul khrims rnam pa gsum yang dag par blang te/ phyogs dang dus dang*/ gnas skabs thams cad du bsrung ba dang bgyi'o// snyam du sdom pa bzung ba la mchog tu spro ba'i yid kyis dri ba gnyis pa'i lan thob mdzod/ ces brda sbyar la/ dri ba dang*/ khas blang pa gong bzhin bya/ slar yang 'di ltar nges par bya ste/

dge ba'i bshes gnyen la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed pa dang bcas te dkon mchog gsum la mi bslu ba'i skyabs su nges pa'i dad pa chen po dang*/ bdag dang sems can thams cad don dam par rang bzhin gyis ma grub kyang*/ kun rdzob sgyu ma dang rmi lam ltar 'khrul snang gi sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig la longs spyod pa rnams phan bde la 'god par 'dod pa'i brtse ba chen po dang*/ de'i ched du mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par 'dod pa'i 'dun pa chen po ste chen po gsum dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo/ rgyal sras rnams kyi bslab par bya ba'i gzhi/ bsod nams dang yon tan mtha' yas pa'i gter du gyur pa byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa nyid yang dag par blangs te/ rnam pa kun tu bslab par bgyi'o snyams pa'i 'dun pa rtse gcig pas dri ba gsum pa'i lan thob mdzod/ ces brjod la/ dri ba khas blangs ba sngar bzhin bya/ da ltar lan gsum gyi bar du dris shing khas blangs pas khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud la byang chub sems kyi dngos gzhi nges par skye ba yin pas skyes nges snyam du thob shes kyi dga' ba khyad par can bskyed mdzod/ ces brjod par bya'o/ /gsum pa mjug gi cho ga la/ mkhyen par gsol ba dang*/ phan yon bstan pa dang*/ gsang bar gdams pa dang*/ bslab bya bstan pa dang*/ gtong rag dbul ba ste rnam pa lngar yod pa las/ dang po mkhyen par (361)gsol ba ni slob dpon gyis bgyi bar gda' ste/ zhes brda' sbyar la/ slob ma rnams tsog tsog pur 'khod du gzhug /slob dpon rang nyid khri las babs te/ rten rnams kyi drung du zhal shar du phyogs pas 'khod pa'i mdun du/ me tog sil mas bkang ba'i snod dang*/ bdug spos kyi reng bu'am spos phor dag bshams/ de nas shar phyogs su phyag gsum 'tshal la/ phyag re re la/

shar phyogs kyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo// zhes lan re brjod pa'i mthar me tog snyim pa gang shar phyogs su gtor zhing*/ bdug spos kyang 'bul ba'i tshul bya/ yid kyis shar phyogs 'jig gyi rten gyi khams bsam gyis mi khyab pa na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa'i sprin gyi char chen po phab par bsam/ tshul de bzhin gyis rigs 'gre pas/ lho phyogs sogs phyogs lhag ma gsum dang*/ mtshams bzhi dang*/ 'og phyogs kyi dod du nub dang*/ steng phyogs kyi dod shar rnams su phyag dang mchod pa 'bul ba rnams go rim ma 'khrul bar byas pa'i mthar/ rten la zhal phyogs pas pus mo la yas pa'i lhang sa la btsug /me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo snying gar sbyar/ mdun du spos btul la 'dun pa rtse gcig pas mkhyen par gsol ba ni/ byang chub sems dpa' slob ma so so'i ming nas smos la/ ming 'di/ zhes bya bas bdag byang chub sems dpa'/ rang gi ming nas smos la/ /zhes bya ba las// byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blang bar bya ba lan gsum gyi bar du yang dag par ma nos pa lags te/ byang chub sems dpa' slob ma'i ming nas smos la/ zhes bgyi bas byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa la/ bdag rang gi ming smos la/ /zhes bgyi ba dpang du gyur pas 'phags pa'i mchog lkog tu gyur kyang*/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi mtha' gtugs pa'i chos thams cad lkog tu ma gyur pa'i thugs mnga' ba thams cad la mkhyen par gsol lo/ /zhes me tog 'thor ba dang bcas pas lan gsum du brjod pa na phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams (362)cad kyis ye shes gzigs pas mngon sum mkhyen cing rjes su brtse bas dgongs par bsam mo// de nas slob dpon gyis/

de dag gis mkhyen par gsol ba'i dngos gzhi grub pa lags pas/ khyed rang rnams kyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi zhabs kyi pad+mo dri ma med pa la mgo bos rab tu gtugs te gus pas phyag 'tshal ba'i mos pa dang bcas slob dpon dang lhan cig tu phyag gsum mdzad par zhu/ zhes brda sbyar la/ slob dpon rang nyid kyis bskul te/ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /sogs nas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod/ zhes pa'i brda brjod nas rten la phyag gsum btsal/ de ltar phyag 'tshal nas/ slar yang bdag dang sems can thams cad 'khor ba las langs par bsams la ker gyis langs te thal mo spyi bor sbyar bar zhu/ zhes brjod la de ltar byed du gzhug go /de nas slob dpon dang*/ slob ma gnyis ka 'greng bzhin du/ slob dpon gyis phyag g.yas pa skyabs sbyin gyi tshul dang bcas te/ 'di skad du/ des mkhyen par gsol ba yan lag dang bcas pa grub nas/ gnyis pa phan yon bstan pa ni/ 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes sngon du 'gro bas slob ma rnams kyi ming nas smos la/ ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod nyon cig /'di ltar byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa nyi shu pa las/ de tshe de la dge ba'i phyir// rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kyis// dge ba'i thugs kyis rtag par yang*// bu sdug 'dra bar dgongs par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'di ni chos nyid yin te/ gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yang dag par len pa'i las brjod pa rdzogs pa'i tshe/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la 'di lta bu'i ltas 'byung bar 'gyur te/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis 'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di lta bu zhig na/ byang chub sems dpa'/ slob ma'i ming (363)nas smos la/ ming 'di

zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' rang gi ming nas smos la/ ming 'di zhes bya ba las/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blang ba mnos zhes yang dag par mkhyen par 'gyur ro// de la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' de rnams kyis chos kyi brtse bas bu dang spun zla'i tshul du dgongs par mdzad la/ de ltar dgongs par mdzad pas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes brjod par bya'o// de nas dpon slob gnyis ka 'dug nas/ slob dpon gyis/ gsum pa byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa blangs pa 'di nyid dad pa med pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya'o// zhes gsang bar gdams pa ni 'di yin te/ byang chub sems dpa'/ ming 'di/ zhes bya ba khyod nyon cig /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa 'di dad pa med pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya te/ gang gi phyir dad pa med pa rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa rab tu bstan na dad pa med pa'i sems can de dag gis byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la ma dad pas spong bar byed de/ des na ji srid byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la gnas pas bsod nams kyi phung po dang ldan pa de snyed kyi bsod nams ma yin pa'i phung po de snyed dang ldan par 'gyur ro// gang gi phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems can thams cad sdug bsngal thams cad las yongs su bsrung bar bya ba yin pas sdig pa las bzlog par bya ste// de'i phyir mchog tu dge ba'i byang chub sems dpas gsang bar bya ba yin no/

/zhes brjod par bya'o/ /bzhi pa bslab bya bstan pa ni/ de ltar sdom pa blangs pa tsam gyis mi chog /de'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs spang bya rnams spang zhing*/ mthun pa'i phyogs bslab bya rnams la slob dgos// de'ang spang blang gi yul ngo shes pa la rags las pas/ de'i tshul rgyas par na// theg pa chen po'i mdo dang bstan bcos rnams las rgya cher 'byung ba ltar shes par (364)bya ba yin na'ang*/ 'dir de dag gi snying po mdor bsdus te gdams pa'ang 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ de la spang bya ni/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mīs sdom pa nyi shu pa las// rnyed dang bkur stir chags pa yis// bdag bstod gzhan la smod pa dang*// sdug bsngal mgon med gyur pa la// ser snas chos nor mi ster dang*// gzhan gyis bshags kyang mi nyan par// khros na gzhan la 'tshog pa dang*// theg pa chen po spong byed cing*// dam chos 'drar snang ston pa'o// zhes gsungs pa'i chos bzhi pho 'di la kun nas dkris pa che 'bring chung gsum du yod de/ 'phags pa thogs med kyis byang sa las/ pham pa'i gnas lta bu bzhi po 'di dag ni kun nas dkris pa chung ngu dang*/ 'bring gis ni tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa de byang chub sems dpas btang bar mi 'gyur ro// kun nas dkris pa chen pos ni btang bar 'gyur te/ gang gi phyir byang chub sems dpa' pham pa'i gnas lta bu'i chos bzhi po 'di dag rgyun mi 'chad par kun tu spyad pa dang*/ ngo tsha shes pa dang khrel yod pa chung ngu tsam yang mi bskyed pa dang*/ des mgu bar byed cing de la dga' ba dang*/ de nyid la yon tan du lta ba can du gyur pa ni kun nas dkris pa chen po yin par rig par bya'o// zhes gsungs pas yan lag gsum po de tshang na kun nas dkris pa chen po zhes bya'o// yang byang sa las/ mdor bsdus na rgyu gnyis kho nas byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa btang bar 'gyur te/

bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu smon pa yongs su btang ba dang*/ pham pa'i gnas lta bu'i chos kun nas dkris pa chen pos kun tu spyod pa'o// zhes gsungs shing*/ rnam par gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba las/ de gtong ba ni mdor bsdu na rgyu bzhis 'gyur te/ yang dag par len pa'i sems kyis mi 'dra bar nges pa'i sems bskyed par byed pa dang*/ mi brda 'phrod pa'i drung du 'bul ba dang ldan pa'i tshig brjod par byed (365)pa dang*/ pham pa'i gnas lta bu'i chos bzhi po de dag las thams cad dam re re'i nyes pa 'byin pa dang*/ pham pa'i gnas lta bu'i chos bzhi po thams cad dam re re la kun nas dkris pa chen po'i nyes pa 'byin par byed na byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa btang bar brjod par bya'o// zhes gsungs pas smon pa btang ba dang*/ kun nas dkris pa chen pos pham pa'i gnas lta bu'i chos bzhi gang rung spyad pa dang*/ kun nas dkris pa 'bring po yan chad kyis bzhi ka tshang bar spyad pa dang*/ byang sems kyi sdom pa las bzlog pa'i sdom min skyes pa dang*/ bslab pa phul ba dang lngas sdom pa btang bas/ de dag byung na bshag bsdams dang bsags sbyang byas la sdom pa slar yang blang bar bya ste/ sdom pa nyi shu pa las/ sdom pa slar yang blang bar bya/ zhes gsungs so// kun nas dkris pa 'bring dang chung ngus bzhi po gang rung spyad pa ni/ nyes byas su gtogs la de yang chos gang rung de la ngo tsha dang khrel yod cung zad skye zhing gzhan gyis gsol ba btab na ldog pa ni 'bring yin la/ de ni gang zag gsum yan chad la bshags par bya ste/ snga ma las/ zag pa 'bring ni gsum la bshags/ ces so// chos gang rung de la ngo tsha cher bskyed cing gzhan gyis ma bzlog kyang rang nyid myur du de las ldog pa ni chung ngu yin la/ de dang 'og nas 'byung ba'i nyes byas bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi po rnams ni gang zag gcig yan chad la bshags par bya ste/

de nyid las/ gcig gi mdun du lhag ma rnams/ zhes so// de bzhin du sdom pa nyi shu pa las/ dkon mchog gsum la gsum mi mchod/ ces pa la sogs pa nyes byas bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi po kun slong gi dbang gis nyon mongs can dang*/ nyon mongs can ma yin pa dang*/ ltung med du 'gyur ba'ang yod la/ de dag ni bshags yul med na rang gi sems kyis bshags pas 'dag ste/ snga ma las/ nyon mongs mi mongs bdag sems bzhin/ zhes so// yang (366)byams dang snying rje chen pos kun nas bslangs te gzhan la phan pa chen por 'gyur nges par mthong nas spyad na phal cher ltung med du 'gyur te/ de nyid las/ snying rjer ldan zhing byams phyir dang*// sems dge ba la nyes pa med/ ces gsungs so// bslab bya ni/ tshul khrims gsum po yin te/ byang sa las/ tshul khrims rnam pa gsum po de dag kyang mdor bsdu na/ byang chub sems dpa'i bya ba rnam pa gsum byed de/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims kyis ni gnas par byed do// dge ba'i chos sdud pas ni bdag gi sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su smin par byed do// sems can gyi don bya ba'i tshul khrims kyis ni sems can yongs su smin par byed do// byang chub sems dpa'i bya ba ni gsum po de dag tu zad de/ 'di lta ste/ tshe 'di la bde bar gnas par bya ba'i phyir sems gnas par bya ba dang*/ lus dang sems dub pa med par sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su smin par bya ba dang*/ sems can yongs su smin par byed pa yin te/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims ni de dag tu zad do// ces gsungs pas/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya thams cad gsum po der 'dus pas gsum po de la 'bad de bslab par bya'o// yang rang dang gzhan la tshe 'dir sdug bsngal yang phyi ma phan chad du phan par 'gyur ba'i dge ba ni bsgrub cing sgrub tu gzhug par bya'o// 'di dang phyi ma gnyis kar phan pa dang bde bar 'gyur na bsgrub cing*/

'dir bde yang phyi ma phan chad du sdug bsngal gyi rgyur 'gyur ba ni 'dor zhing 'dor du gzhug par bya ste/ sdom pa nyi shu pa las/ gzhan rnams dang ni bdag la'ang rung*/ sdug bsngal yin yang gang phan pa// phan dang bde ba rnams bya ste// de yang mi phan mi bya'o// zhes gsungs so// de ltar spang bya dang bsgrub bya thams cad kyang byang chub sems dpa'i sa la sogs pa las legs par shes par byas te/ gnas skabs thams cad du dran pa dang shes bzhin gyis zin par byas nas bslab (367)par bya ste/ slob dpon chen po zhi ba lhas/ bslab pa bsrung bar 'dod pa yis// rab tu bsgrim ste sems bsrung bya/ zhes pa dang*/ sems bsrung 'dod pa rnams kyis ni// dran pa dang ni shes bzhin dag /srog la bab kyang srungs shig ces// bdag ni de skad 'doms par byed/ ces gsungs pas dran pa shes bzhin dang ldan pas bslab pa rnams la legs par bslab par bya'o// lnga pa gtong rag 'bul ba ni/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yang dag par blang ba thob pa de nyid bla ma dang dkon mchog gi bka' drin las byung bas na/ gtong rag gi slad du phyag dang*/ mchod pas bsnyen bkur ba skabs su babs pa yin pas/ thog mar gnas lngas la gtugs pa'i phyag dang bcas te 'di gsung bar zhu/ ji snyed su dag / sogs sh+lo ka bzhi tshar gcig /de nas mchod pa gsar ba thad du bshams la/ slob dpon gyis sngar bzhin byin gyis brlabs zin pa dang*/ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba la/ dngos su bshams pa'i mchod pa dang*/ lus dbul ba'i mchod pa dang*/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i sprin rab 'byams kyis mchod pa dang gsum po sngar ji skad bshad pa'i dmigs pa rnams yid la dran bzhin pa'i sgo nas rim bzhin du 'bul bar zhu/ zhes brda sbyar la/ oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ghaṃ sogs sngags rkyang pa'am tshigs bcad dang spel ba ji ltar rigs pas dngos bshams/ rgyal dang de sras rnams la

sogs sh+tso ka gcig gis lus dbul ba/ me tog dam pa sogs sh+tso ka gcig gis yid sprul gyi mchod pa rnams 'bul du gzhug go /de rnams kyis spyir bla ma dang dkon mchog la phyag dang mchod pa phul nas/ khyad par slob dpon la bka' drin rjes su dran pas gus pa'i 'du shes bskyed de phyag gsum mdzad par zhu/ zhes phyag gsum 'tshal du bcug zin pa dang*/ 'grong ste 'dud pa dang bcas pas/ bka' drin che lags/ ces brjod du gzhug go / spyi don gsum pa rang bzhin gtan la dbab pa ni/ smon 'jug gi sems de dag gang las skye ba'i rgyu dang*/ rang gi (368)ngo bo dang*/ de yi rab tu dbye ba dang*/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu 'byin pa'i phan yon la sogs pa yin na'ang*/ snga ma rnams ni theg pa chen po shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo sde rnams dang*/ rgyal ba'i sras po ma pham pa'i mdo sde'i rgyan dang*/ 'phags pa thogs med zhabs kyi byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang*/ slob dpon chen po tsan+d+ra go mīs sdom pa nyi shu pa sogs las rgya cher gsungs pas de rnams su gzigs pas khyab cing*/ phan yon ni/ cho ga shin tu rgyas par byed na cho ga'i skabs su'ang bshad par bya ba yin pas/ 'dir cung zad brjod par bya ste/ byams pa'i smon lam gyi mdo las/ ngan 'gro thams cad zlog bgyid cing*// mtho ris lam ni rab ston la// rga shi med par 'dren bgyid pa'i// byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs/ dpas byin gyis zhus pa las// byang chub sems kyi bsod nams gang*// gal te de la gzugs mchis na// nam mkha'i khams ni kun bkang ste// de bas kyang ni lhag par 'gyur// gaṅgā'i bye ma'i grangs snyed kyi// sangs rgyas zhing kun mi gang gis// rin chen dag gis kun bkang ste// 'jig rten mgon la phul ba bas// gang gis thal mo sbyar bgyis te// byang chub tu ni sems btud na// mchod pa de ni khyad par 'phags// de la mtha' ni ma mchis so// zhes gsungs shing*/

de ltar bsod nams mtha' yas pa 'byung ba'i gtan tshig kyang*/ rin chen phreng ba las/ sems can khams ni tshad med la// phan 'dod de ni de 'dra'o// zhes gsungs// blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa las/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems dang chos 'dzin dang*// chos sgrub pa dang srog chags snying brtse ba// chos bzhi 'di dag yon tan mtha' med de// 'di dag mtha' ni rgyal bas mi gsung ngo*// zhes gsungs/ seng ges zhus pa las/ sems can thams cad thar bya'i phyir// byang chub don du sems btud pa// des ni chos rnams bsdu ba thob// de ni dga' (369)ba thob par 'gyur// zhes gsungs/ sdong po bkod pa'i mdo las kyang*// rigs kyi bu byang chub kyi sems ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi sa bon lta bu'o// 'gro ba thams cad kyi chos dkar po thams cad rnam par 'phel bar byed pas zhing sa lta bu'o// 'jig rten thams cad bsten pas sa lta bu'o// zhes bya ba nas// byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bsrung bas pha lta bu'o// zhes bya ba'i bar dang*/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ dbul ba thams cad gcod pas rnam thos kyi bu lta bu'o// don thams cad yang dag par sgrub pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal po lta bu'o// bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pas bum pa bzang po lta bu'o// nyon mongs pa'i dgra pham par byed pas mdung thung lta bu'o// tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i yid la byed pa 'gebs pas go cha lta bu'o// nyon mongs pa rim go lhung bar byed pas ral gri lta bu'o// nyon mongs pa'i shing gcod pas sta re lta bu'o// 'tshe ba thams cad las skyob pas mtshon cha lta bu'o// 'khor ba'i chu nang na gnas pa steng du 'byin pas mchil pa lta bu'o// sgrib bas khebs pa'i rtsa thams cad rnam par 'thor bas rlung gi dkyil 'khor lta bu'o// byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang smon lam bsdus pa'i phyir mdor bstan pa lta bu'o// lha dang mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten na mchod rten lta bu ste/
