rigs kyi bu de ltar byang chub kyis sems ni phan yon de dag dang yon tan gyi bye brag tshad med pa gzhan dang yang ldan no// zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang*/ mkhas pas byang chub sems bsgoms ni// rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams mchod// 'di ni skyon med me tog ste// rab tu dri zhim rnam par mdzes// thabs 'dis ring po mi thogs par// rgyal mchog sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur// gzhan yang 'dod pa'i 'bras rnams 'grub// ces gsungs/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ bdag nyid dang ni 'jig rten 'dis// (370)bla med byang chub thob 'dod na// de yi rtsa ba byang chub sems// ri dbang rgyal po ltar brtan dang*// phyogs mthas gtugs pa'i snying rje dang*// gnyis la mi brten ye shes lags// zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang mdo las 'byung ba'i don byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug par mang du gsungs pa sogs la nges shes khyad par can bskyed de/ ji skad bshad pa'i bslab bya rnams la spang blang tshul bzhin du bsgrubs pa'i legs byas kyi snang bas rang gzhan rnams kyi phan bde'i pad+mo mchog tu rgyas pa'i thabs la brtson par bya'o// zhes brjod/ skabs 'dir phyag len 'ga' zhig pa gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal la sogs bshad kyang spro na 'gal ba med mod/ sngar gtong rag gi phyag mchod rgyas par grub pa'i phyir ma byas kyang chog go / de ltar na de rnams kyi sgo nas dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ mtha' yas pa'i rgyal ba'i sras po rnams kyi 'jug sgo/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab theg pa chen po shin tu rgyas pa'i lugs kyi byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i chog / smon sems dang*/ 'jug sdom so sor bzung ba'i tshul dge ba'i bshes gnyen brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i phyag len bzhin legs par phul grub pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re rnams kyis chos nyan bshad byas pa las byung ba'i bsod nams kyi phung po dpag tu med pa zhig yod pa de dag par mdor chud mi 'dza' bar/

byang chub chen po'i rgyur smin ma'i slad du yongs su bsngo bas rgyas gdab dgos pas bsngo ba dang smon lam gyi mthun 'gyur thugs la 'dog par zhu/ zhes mtshams sbyar la/ spyir bsngo ba rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs par bya ba'am/ yang na/ bsngo bas rgyas gdab dgos pas/ zhes pa yan gong ltar la/ bsngo ba dang smon lam lhan cig tu gnang bar zhu/ zhes dang*/ 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa dang*/ byams pa'i smon lam sogs bsngo smon rgyas par bya zhing*/ gang ltar yang*/ mdo sde las 'byung ba'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa dang bcas me tog gi char sil ma dgram par bya'o// 'dir 'phros don cung zad brjod na/ gong du bshad pa bzhi ni smon sems rkyang bar (371)so thar rigs bdun gang rung sngon du 'gro ba dang*/ snod brtag pa sogs gang yang mi dgos pas don gnyer thams cad la sbyin du rung ba'i phyir/ spyi bo mang po tshogs pa la sems bskyed na 'di'i smon pa sems bskyed kho na bya/ de yang gong bshad kyi skabs su sems bskyed dang sdom pa'i cho ga zhes pa la/ sems bskyed kyi cho ga zhes dang*/ sems bskyed dang sdom pa'i rten nges par bya ba la/ sems bskyed kyi rten nges par bya ba zhes dang*/ gnyis pa sbyor ba rjes su sgrub pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba la'ang gsum ste sogs dkyus bzhin la/ smon sems kyi gtong rag 'bul ba'i bar byas nas/

de rnams kyi sgo nas theg pa chen po shin tu rgyas pa'i lugs kyi sems bskyed kyi cho ga yan lag dang bcas pa legs par phul grub pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re rnams kyis chos nyan bshad byas pa las byung ba'i/ zhes sogs gong bzhin sprel la dge ba bsngos pas don 'grub bo// gal te don gnyer dmigs bsal la 'jug sdom sbyin na/ spyir yang len pa po'i gang zag gi skabs su bshad pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad tshang ba dang*/ khyad par theg pa chen po'i mdo sde ji snyed pa'am/ de tsam ma nus kyang byang pa'am/ bslab btus lta bu nyan nas go don 'phrod pa byung na shin tu legs/ ma mtha' yang 'phags pa dkon mchog sprin nas/ nam mkha'i snying pos zhus pa lta bu'i mdo sde zhig gi bklag lung tsam nges par thob pa gal che ste/ sngar lam rim dang blo sbyong sogs brjod bya don gyi theg chen nyan pa zhig yin du zin na'ang rjod byed tshig gi theg chen gyi mdo sde zhig ma thos pa'i thabs med do// de bzhin du phyag len gyi rim pa'ang gong du ji skad bshad pa bzhin las sngags kyi cho gas rgyas btab pa dang*/ sla chos sogs gang dran byas na chos la dbang za ba'i nyes pa ni tshad med pa'i phyir bag yod par bya'o// de ltar sems bskyed dang sdom pa'i tshul la gnas pa'i gang zag gis theg pa chen po'i lam la slob par bya ba yin pas/ de dag gi blo gros kyi sgo dbye ba'i phyir lam gyi rim pa'ang mdor bsdu na/ mgon po byams pas mdo sde'i rgyan las/ rigs dang chos la mos pa dang*// de bzhin du ni sems bskyed dang*// sbyin pa la sogs bsgrub pa dang*// sems can rnams yongs smin byed dang*// skyon med pa la 'jug nyid dang*// zhing ni yongs su dag pa dang*// mi gnas (372)mya ngan 'das pa dang*// byang chub mchog lam ston pa'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thog mar skal pa dang ldan pa'i gzhi theg pa chen po'i rigs sad pa'i rtags su snying rje dang*/

mos pa dang*/ bzod pa dang*/ dge ba sogs la mngon par spro ba'i gang zag gis/ chos 'di pa la mi phyed pa'i mos pas mtshams sbyar te bstan pa spyi'i 'jug sgo skyabs 'gro dang*/ bye brag theg chen gyi 'jug sgo byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa sngon du 'gro bas rang smin par byed pa sbyin pa la sogs pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug bsgrub cing*/ gzhan sems can rnams yongs su smin par byed pa bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la mnyam rjes gnyis kyi sgo nas ci nus su 'bad pas rang shugs kyis chos las blo gzhan du mi 'gro zhing*/ dad pa dang*/ nges 'byung dang*/ bsom pa sogs la sun pa med par pad+mo'i mtsho la ngang mo 'jug pa bzhin spro ba ngang gis 'phel ba na tshogs lam chung ngu thog mar rgyud la skyes pa yin no// de nas ting nge 'dzin skyon med pa dang*/ zhing yongs su dag pa 'phags pa'i chos la 'jug pa'i slad du lam la 'bad pas/ bden pa bzhi'i don la gsal snang cung zad rnyed pa ni tshogs lam/ de nyid bsgom pa'i stobs dang*/ tshogs bsags pa'i stobs gnyis 'dzom pas phung po lnga sgyu ma ltar rtogs shing*/ chos kyi bdag med la gsal snang rim gyis rnyed pa ni sbyor lam/ bdag med gnyis kyi don ji bzhin pa dang por mthong ba mthong lam/ mthong zin pa'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can gyi 'jug ngogs la goms par byed pa bsgom lam/ shes bya dang spang bya mthar phyin pa mi slob pa'i lam ste/ de yang mthong lam gyi ye shes khong du chud pa dang*/ sa dang po gsar du thob pa dus mnyam/ de nas bsgom lam gyis sa dgu pa'i bar bgrod nas/ mi slob pa'i lam du sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin rgya mtshor 'jug pa ste/ mdor na de lta bu'i lam dang sa de dag kyang don dam sems bskyed la (373)brten nas/ shes rab stong nyid bsgoms pas nyer len gyi rgyu dang*/ thabs snying rje chen pos lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen byas nas lam lnga 'grub/

kun rdzob sems bskyed la brten nas/ thabs snying rjes nyer len gyi rgyu dang*/ shes rab stong pa nyid kyis lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen byas nas sa bcu thob la/ sangs rgyas pa na'ang lam mthar thug pa chos sku dang*/ sa mthar thug pa gzugs sku yin no// de ltar sa lam mthar phyin pa'i 'bras bu ni/ shes rab chen pos 'khor ba dang*/ snying rje chen pos mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtha' la mi gnas/ byang chub mchog ste sangs rgyas kyi sa'i yon tan mtha' dag lhun gyis grub/ nam mkha' ji srid bar du sems can gyi khams la lam ston pa'i phrin las rgyun mi 'chad par 'gyur ba ni nges pa'o// de ltar theg chen shin tu rgyas pa'i sems bskyed sdom pa'i cho ga'i tshul/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam bzang gang de gsal bar bshad pa'i legs byas kyis/ shes rab chen pos srid las 'das kyang snying rjes zhi mthar ltung min pa'i// sku dang ye shes phrin las rmad byung kun mkhyen go 'phang myur thob shog /ces pa'ang yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po dpal sa skya pa 'jam dpal gzhon nu ngag dbang rdo rje rin chen bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi thugs bzhed bsgrub pa dang*/ don gnyer can gzhan la'ang phan pa'i bsam pa bzang pos/ yongs 'dzin dam pa chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i bka' drin las theg pa chen po'i gzhung lugs mang du thos pa'i shākya'i btsun pa rmongs brtul kun tu rgyu 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos/ rgyal ba'i sras po thogs med bzang po'i dpal gyi gsung rab la tshig mthar bskyed tshul mi 'gal bas zur brgyan te/ yon tan rin chen du ma'i 'byung gnas dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi bla brang thar pa rtser sbyar ba'o/ 'dis kyang rang gzhan thams cad kyi rgyud la byang chub kyi sems rin po che bcos ma ma yin pa skyes pa'i mthu las/ bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung ba'i rgyur gyur cig

/theg pa chen po shin tu rgyas pa'i lugs kyi sems bskyed dang sdom pa rnam par dag pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ mgon po byams pa/ 'phags pa thogs med/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen/ (374)'phags pa grol sde/ btsun pa rnam grol sde/ mchog gi sde/ dul ba'i sde/ slon dpon seng ge bzang po/ ku sā li che chung gnyis/ gser gling pa chos kyi grags pa/ jo bo rje dpal mar me mdzad/ rgyal ba 'brom ston pa/ spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar/ dge bshes bya yul ba/ rgyal sras char chen pa/ mus sman pa'ang zer/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags/ sangs rgyas sgom pa seṅge skyabs/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ mkhan chen seng ge skyabs/ mkhas btsun bsod nams ye shes/ byang sems bsod nams grags pa/ rgyal sras thogs med bzang po dpal/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ don chen kun dga' bzang po// mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ mkhan chen dkon mchog tshul khrims/ sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rtse'i dbang phyug /rje dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ 'jam mgon kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras bsod nams dbang phyug /lha khang mkhan chen don grub legs bzang*/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar pa legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ mus chen bsod nams dpal bzang*/ mus chen chos nyid ye shes/ mus chen ye shes rgyal mchog /yongs 'dzin rin po che blo gros rgya mtsho/ dpal sa skya pa 'jam mgon bla ma ngag dbang rdo rje rin chen/ thams cad mkhyen pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po/ des bdag la bka' drin chen pos khyab par mdzad pa'o// yang na/ byang sems bsod nams grags pa nas/ bu ston rin chen grub/ thugs sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ mkhan chen grub pa shes rab/ paṇa chen dge 'dun grub/ 'dul 'dzin blo gros sbas pa/ paṇa chen lung rig rgya mtsho/ rje skyabs mchog dpal/

dben sa pa blo bzang don 'grub/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ drung pa brtson 'grus rgya mtsho/ rta phug pa dam chos rgyal mtshan/ sgrub khang pa dge legs rgya mtsho/ phur bu lcog ngag dbang byams pa/ yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan/ bshes gnyen blo bzang rgyal mtshan/ rgyal sras sems dpa' chen po rin chen blo gsal bstan skyong*/ 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos mkhyen brtse'i dbang po/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ rgyal sras thogs med nas/ lo chen byang chub rtse mo/ de dbon lo chen grags rgyal/ bo dong paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal/ byams gling paṇa chen bsod nams rnam rgyal/ gser mdog paṇa chen shā kya mchog ldan/ paṇa chen don yod grub pa/ rje (375)btsun kun dga' 'grol mchog /mkhan chen lung rig rgya mtsho/ rje btsun kun dga' snying po/ rgyal tshab ye shes rgya mtsho/ rje yon tan mgon po/ grub chen mgon po dpal 'byor/ mtshungs med mgon po grags pa/ grub dbang mgon po rnam rgyal/ rig 'dzin 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho/ kun gzigs phrin las shing rta/ rmog lcaugs pa kun dga' dge legs/ kun dga' lhun grub rgya mtsho/ rje bka' brgyud bstan 'dzin/ bla ma karma lhag mthong*/ grub dbang karma nor bu/ des bdag la bka' drin chen pos stsal ba'o/ sarba dā kal+yā ṇi bha wa tu/ (376)
